theme.description: The path of an idk-themetron theme, from the project root: an inputs file (.json), as the themetron playground downloads it, which the site builds; or a CSS export, the "css" format (or "looks"), for token contract 0.2, 0.3, 0.4, or 0.5 (https://method-run.github.io/idk-themetron/schema/0.5.0/tokens.manifest.json). The site loads it before its own stylesheet. --theme overrides it.

looks.description: Themetron's looks.css: its package name, @method-run/idk-themetron/looks.css, or its path from the project root. With looks, the site's buttons, search field, cards, and settings menu wear themetron's tm-look-* classes. A theme built from an inputs file gets the looks of the installed themetron without this; false turns them off. Needs site.theme or --theme.
